task.title: Refresh QMD for Sunday decision packet and blocker-lineage docs
task.body:
Context: The QMD Whiteford collection was refreshed before the latest Sunday morning decision packet/re-review were created. The watchdog verified `qmd search "approval command center"` works, but `qmd search "Sunday decision packet"` did not yet retrieve the newest decision docs.

Objective:
- Run local-only QMD maintenance so the newest Sunday decision packet and re-review are indexed.
- Use the known working invocation when needed: `PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" qmd ...`.
- Commands to consider: `qmd status`, `qmd update`, bounded `qmd embed --max-docs-per-batch 50 --max-batch-mb 10`, then searches for `Sunday morning decision packet`, `Supabase blocker t_fa6eb9c1 t_53d470c6`, and `Tech GC local no-token QA` scoped to `whiteford-ai-law-pages`.

Deliverables expected:
- Write `/Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/ops/qmd_sunday_decision_refresh_2026-05-10.md` with before/after status, exact commands, and search evidence.
- Update `/Users/jeff/Documents/Codex/2026-05-05/i-want-to-install-hermes-agent/whiteford-ai-law-pages/docs/KANBAN_DELIVERABLE_INDEX.md`.
- Leave the standard Kanban deliverable comment.

Acceptance criteria:
- QMD retrieves the Sunday decision packet/re-review or the report explains the remaining local-index issue and safe fix.
- Do not delete collections or overwrite source docs.
- No external/public action, no CRM/HighLevel mutation, no Supabase DDL/sync/backfill/row mutation, no Clio, no email/social/LinkedIn/ad action, and no credential changes.

latest_summary: Refreshed local QMD indexing for the Sunday decision packet and blocker-lineage docs, then documented before/after status and search evidence in docs/ops/qmd_sunday_decision_refresh_2026-05-10.md. `whiteford-ai-law-pages` increased from 179 to 182 indexed files and searches now retrieve the Sunday packet, review, re-review, Supabase blocker lineage, and Tech GC local/no-token QA docs; the deliverable index and standard Kanban comment were updated.
